[ -s "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/context/devteam/consistency-drift.md" ] && { echo '⚠ 上次留有未解的文件一致性 drift，請優先補償（修正後 drift 自動清除）：'; cat "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/context/devteam/consistency-drift.md"; } || true
